subject: Latent Semantic Analysis for text files comparison

messages.author: 341512c8cde6b2fc
messages.subject: Latent Semantic Analysis for text files comparison
parts:
Hello everyone,

I am currently working on a corpus made of 23 .txt files. I would like to plot the results of a Latent Semantic Analysis to see how similar each file is to the others.
To do so, I have tried following the instructions provided by Cheng at the following URL:
http://meefen.github.io/blog/2013/03/11/analyze-text-similarity-in-r-latent-semantic-analysis-and-multidimentional-scaling/
and made use of the tm, lsa and ggplot2 libraries.

I think I messed with the file loading process, since I get the following error message when running the TermDocumentMatrix function:

Error in UseMethod("meta", x):  no applicable method for "meta" applied to an object of class "character"

and

Warning message:  In mclapply(unnamed(content(x)), termFreq, control) : all scheduled cores encountered errors in user code.

May I ask your help to solve this problem (or find an alternative way)?

Thank you in advance,
Claudio




___________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
Further info about the files:

Each file contains contains 1m Italian tokens.
The corpus represents 23 different semantic domains.
As mentioned in Cheng's blog, stopwords, punctuation and numbers are removed in the preprocessing stage.
